title: OpusClip · You don't need an editor

scenes.line: You don't need an editor to post clips every day.
scenes.cue: The Controversy hook. Flat, certain. Hit 'editor'.

scenes.line: Paste in one long video. A podcast, a talk.
scenes.cue: The 60 rolls up while you talk. Don't say the number, the screen owns it.

scenes.line: It finds the best moments and captions them.
scenes.cue: Matter-of-fact. The cards land on the beat.

scenes.line: One hour of podcast is your whole free month.
scenes.cue: The honest math. Slight weight on 'whole'.

scenes.line: Paste the link. Keep the best clips. Export vertical, captions on.
scenes.cue: Three beats, one per step as the dots fill.

scenes.line: The catch: watermarks, and three days to download.
Comment CLIP. I'll send the steps.
scenes.cue: Slowest line in the reel. A door, not a pitch.
